> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from Elsevier publisher pages and domain knowledge of experimental child psychology editorial culture (Cognitive Development Society overlap). Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High — child diversity sampling encouraged |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Experimental child psychology — cognitive development, language acquisition, social cognition development, executive function development, theory of mind, numerical cognition |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **experimental child psychology contribution** — controlled studies on child cognitive / social / linguistic development. Multi-experiment programs preferred.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure qualitative or observational work without experimental rigor redirected.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts outside experimental child psychology scope
- AI use without disclosure per Elsevier policy
- Insufficient IRB / child-protection documentation
- Single-cross-sectional designs without strong theoretical justification

### Soft Tax

Low for experimental child psychology tradition authors. 24-month AAM embargo on subscription path.

### Best Suited For

- Experimental cognitive development studies
- Language acquisition empirical research
- Theory of mind and social-cognition development
- Executive function and working memory development
- Numerical cognition development
- Multi-experiment child research programs

### Not Recommended For

- Clinical child psychopathology (consider J Abn Child Psych)
- Pure observational developmental work
- Pure qualitative work
- Adolescent / adult research

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Developmental Psychology](./developmental-psychology.md) | APA family; broader lifespan focus |
| 2 | *(Child Development — community contribution welcome to add SRCD flagship)* | SRCD flagship for cognitive-developmental work |
| 3 | [Journal of Experimental Psychology Learning Memory and Cognition](../cognitive-science/journal-of-experimental-psychology-learning-memory-and-cognition.md) | If methodology generalizes to adult-cognitive paradigm |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from Developmental Psychology as "too cognitive-experimental," JECP is the Elsevier home for experimental child cognitive research.
